cautions: Source E3 savings/income; E4 debt service/income; E5 liquid assets / (annual expense/12); E6 net worth.
Reference thresholds are savings 10%, debt service below 50%, emergency reserve 6 months, positive net worth. User saving target is 50%, not source 10%.
Missing income/expenses must show incomplete, not a healthy zero.
